title: Public-Participation Directory
description: Static reference directory of how the public weighs in on legislation in each U.S. jurisdiction (witness slip, Request to Speak, position letter, written testimony, public comment, etc.), with a link to the official portal. Consumed by docs/src/dashboard/index.html to show a 'how to weigh in — by state' directory alongside the live committee-hearings feed. Reference data, updated by hand as portals change — not scraped.

tips.description: Short, general tips for taking part, shown with every place.

online.description: Whether participation can be done online.

how_to.description: What a resident does to weigh in, answer first, with no comparisons to other states.

participate_label.description: Overrides the link's wording when the participate_url is a how-to page rather than the form itself (e.g. Oregon: "How to testify").

participate_url.description: Set only when the official page is itself the tool for taking part (a sign-in, slip, comment or request-to-speak form), not a homepage or calendar. Every hearing row links it.
